messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh! What's this here?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1c 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0a 00}Oh, yay!
Did you find this just for 
little ol' me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Wow,{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm so impressed by
your great taste and your
big heart!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi! Mis see siin on?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 1c 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0a 00}Oi, jee!
Kas sa leidsid selle just
väikese minu jaoks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Vau,{01 00 00 0f 00} ma olen nii muljet
avaldatud sinu maitsest ja
suurest südamest!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}What?!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Did you say you
were going to give me this
{0b 02 00}{04 1c 00}?
So, {01 00 00 0f 00}are you saying you want
me to wear it?

{07 14 00}OK then,{01 00 00 0f 00} as you wish.{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
gonna get all dolled up now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mis?!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00} Kas sa ütlesid, et
kavatsed mulle kinkida selle
{0b 02 00}{04 1c 00}?
Nii et, {01 00 00 0f 00}sa tahad, et ma
seda kannaksin?

{07 14 00}Olgu siis,{01 00 00 0f 00} nagu soovid.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma
lähen end nüüd ilusaks
tegema, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Wow! {01 00 00 05 00}Check it out! That
{0b 02 00}{04 1c 00}
is so lovely!
{07 00 00}It seems that you're
beginning to understand
what beauty is.
Well then,{01 00 00 05 00} I guess I have to
go try this on!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Vau! {01 00 00 05 00}Vaata seda! See
{0b 02 00}{04 1c 00}
on nii armas!
{07 00 00}Tundub, et sa hakkad
mõistma,
mis on ilu.
No nii,{01 00 00 05 00} ma vist pean
seda proovima!
